name: 再次幸福
overview: The kind and virtuous Luo Meihao, unable to endure her husband's oppression, chose to divorce him. After the divorce, Luo Meihua struggled to raise her child alone. One day, she encountered a "homeless man." Kind-hearted Luo Meihao selflessly helped and cared for him. This amnesiac "homeless man" turned out to be the president of a listed company, and during their time together, he secretly developed feelings for the kind-hearted Luo Meihao...
